info.name: DocInfra API v1
info.description:
Collection for the DocInfra API v1: text and DOCX rewrite, DOCX and HTML to PDF conversion, jobs, documents, usage, plan and webhooks.

## Quickstart

1. Create a free account at https://app.apidocinfra.com.
2. In the dashboard, create an API key (`doc_test_...` or `doc_live_...`). It is shown once.
3. Select the **DocInfra** environment and paste the key into `DOCINFRA_API_KEY`. Every request sends it as `Authorization: Bearer {{DOCINFRA_API_KEY}}`.

Then send **Text Rewrite > Rewrite text**. For files, send a conversion or a DOCX rewrite (`202`), then **Jobs > Get job** until `status` is `completed`. `job_id`, `document_id` and `webhook_id` are stored automatically from the responses.

## Preservation guarantee

Numbers, percentages, money, dates, URLs, emails, citations, code and your `protected_terms` never reach the model: they are replaced by markers before the call and each marker has to come back exactly once and in the same order. If that cannot be achieved in two attempts, `POST /v1/text/rewrite` answers `422 PRESERVATION_FAILED` and returns no text, and a document rewrite job ends `failed` with the same code without delivering a document. Accuracy is never traded for a rewrite.

Errors are `application/problem+json` with a stable `code`; decide on `code`, not on `title` or `detail`. Every response carries `X-Request-Id`.

exec: // Idempotency-Key is required on these two endpoints (docs: API v1).

item.name: Text Rewrite
item.description: Synchronous rewrite of plain text. Beta.

request.description:
Rewrites a text so it reads naturally, keeping its meaning, its language and every protected element (numbers, dates, URLs, emails, citations, code and `protected_terms`). Synchronous.

Expect `200` with the rewritten `text` and `metrics`. `Idempotency-Key` is optional here; add it by hand if you want safe retries (a replay within one hour returns the same response with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`).

If protection cannot be guaranteed the API answers `422 PRESERVATION_FAILED` and returns no text. Status: beta, enabled per workspace (`403 REWRITE_NOT_ENABLED` otherwise).

response.name: 200 OK (response shape)

item.name: Document Rewrite
item.description: Asynchronous rewrite of a DOCX. Returns a job. Beta.

request.description:
Uploads a `.docx` and queues a rewrite of its prose. The result is a DOCX with the same structure (styles, lists, tables, links, images, headers and footers). Asynchronous.

Expect `202` with `job_id` and `document_id`; the collection stores both. Then poll **Jobs > Get job** until `status` is `completed` and download `download_url`.

`Idempotency-Key` is required; the pre-request script adds a random one. Pick the file in the `file` field before sending. Macro-enabled documents are rejected with `415`. Status: beta, enabled per workspace.

item.name: Document Conversion
item.description: DOCX or HTML to PDF. Returns a job.

request.description:
Uploads a DOCX and queues its conversion to PDF. The request returns right away; the worker converts it.

Expect `202` with `job_id`, `document_id` and `status: queued`; the collection stores the ids. Poll **Jobs > Get job** until `completed`.

`Idempotency-Key` is required; the pre-request script adds a random one. Pick the file in the `file` field before sending.

Same as the DOCX request with an `.html` file.

Expect `202` with `job_id` and `document_id`.

Returns the job status: `queued`, `processing`, `completed`, `failed` or `rejected`. `type` is `convert` or `rewrite`.

Expect `200`. When `status` is `completed` the body has `download_url` (valid 5 minutes, a new one on every call). Download it with a plain `GET` and no headers; do not send the API key to the storage URL. On `failed` or `rejected` the body has `error.code` and `error.message`.

`job_id` is filled automatically from the last `202` response.

Lists your documents, newest first. Optional query parameters: `limit` (1 to 100, default 20), `status` (`received`, `processed`, `failed`, `rejected`) and `cursor` (the `next_cursor` of the previous page).

Expect `200`.

Returns one document. When it is processed, not deleted and not expired, the body includes `download_url` and `download_url_expires_at`.

Expect `200`, or `404 DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND`.

Deletes the stored files of a document (original and result). Repeating it is safe.

Expect `204` with no body. `409 DOCUMENT_IN_PROGRESS` while the job is still `queued` or `processing`.

Usage for one month: operations, successful, failed and rejected jobs, bytes, and words for `text_rewrite` and `document_rewrite`. Optional `period` in `YYYY-MM` (current UTC month by default).

Expect `200`.

The plan of the workspace that owns the API key, its limits for the billing period and what has been used (`meters`). `limit: -1` means no limit. Read only; subscriptions are managed in the dashboard.

Expect `200`.

item.name: Webhooks
item.description: Register endpoints for document events. Signature verification is described in the webhooks guide.

request.description:
Registers an HTTPS endpoint for document events: `document.completed`, `document.failed`, `document.rejected`, `document.deleted`.

Expect `201`. The response includes `secret` (`whsec_...`) only this once: store it to verify signatures. The collection stores `webhook_id`. `Idempotency-Key` is optional; a replay with the same key and body returns `200` without `secret`.

Lists active webhook endpoints. Never includes `secret`.

Expect `200`.

Deletes a webhook endpoint and cancels its pending deliveries. Repeating it is safe.

Expect `204` with no body.
